**A.** Article 31(1) of the Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties sets the general rule: good faith, ordinary meaning of the terms, in their context, and in light of the treaty's object and purpose. The team note's suggested answers (C and D) don't hold up. C overstates preparatory works, which Article 32 treats only as a supplementary means, and D takes only one element of the rule. I'm keeping A.

CONFIDENCE: 97
